title: Revisiting the remember-know task: Replications of Gardiner and Java (1990)
authors: Julia M. Haaf, Stephen Rhodes, Moshe Naveh-Benjamin, Tony Sun, Hope K. Snyder, Jeffrey N. Rouder
caption_short: Schematic of the replications: words and nonwords studied for 2 s each, a 10-minute spot-the-difference task, then old / new judgements with a remember / know judgement after each 'old'.
notes: Drawn by us: the replication paper (CC BY 4.0, PMC7491359) has four figures, all results (Figs. 1-4). The original Gardiner & Java (1990) article (Memory & Cognition 18:23-30, doi 10.3758/BF03202642) could not be downloaded (Springer bot check), so its figures were not checked. Procedure from Haaf et al. Experiment 1 Procedure (2 s per item, 0.5 s gap, 10-minute spot-the-difference task), which Experiments 2 and 4 follow; list lengths from the Experiment 2 and 4 Methods. Example items are illustrative, not from the data.
